id: title:danielcarletti:report repartition rewrite progress instead of per batch noise

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse rewrite progress reporting and row-count metadata support.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F2.H1 adds a helper to format warehouse partition schemes into readable strings, supporting debugging and logging. P1.F2.H2 adds an optional `total_rows` parameter to the rewrite function, establishing the API support for progress reporting and ETA calculation. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for warehouse ingestion and management.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the progress-reporting and flush behavior; P1.F2.H4, P1.F2.H5, and P1.F2.H6 are not supplied. The tier is assigned based on the visible API and formatting changes, not the complete end-to-end behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new progress-reporting and flush behavior. P1.F2.H4 and P1.F2.H5 show the removal of the return value and the addition of the progress dictionary and logging, but P1.F2.H4 also removes the return statement and P1.F2.H5 removes the return statement. P1.F2.H6 removes the return statement. P1.F2.H7 adds the total_rows. P1.
